record.dic_text:
03075 Y@howzabad {yeh-ho-zaw-bawd'}

源自 03068 和 02064; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Jehozabad 4; 4

約薩拔 = "耶和華已賜與"
1) 摩押人朔默 [7763]和妻子示米利 [8116]的兒子, 他謀殺了猶大王
   約阿施 (#王下 12:21; 代下 24:26|)
2) 約沙法王手下一位便雅憫的軍長, 統帥十八萬戰士 (#代下 17:18|)
3) 大衛王時的一位哥轄的利未人, 俄別以東的次子, 負責看守聖幕及
   庫房的人之一 (#代上 26:4|)
record.edic_text:
03075 Y@howzabad {yeh-ho-zaw-bawd'}

from 03068 and 02064;; n pr m

AV - Jehozabad 4; 4

Jehozabad = "Jehovah has endowed"
1) son of Shomer, a Moabitish woman, who murdered Joash, king of Judah
2) a Benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of
   Jehoshaphat
3) a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of
   the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David
